title: Extract remaining non-chat provider protocol DTO and response parser modules
description: TASK-022 extracted chat, MiniMax TTS SSE, and Xinference parser DTOs, but other non-chat provider adapters still combine payload DTOs, response parsing, error parsing, and adapter orchestration. Record a follow-up boundary so embedding, STT, TTS, and rerank protocol shapes do not keep growing inside concrete adapter files.

files.change: Move embedding request and response vector parsing out of the adapter.
Move embedContent and batchEmbedContents request/response parsing plus Gemini error extraction.
Move OpenAI, Gemini, Volcengine, and other TTS protocol payload and response extraction helpers out of concrete adapters without moving artifact writing.
Move Bailian and VLLM rerank payload/response parsing out of adapters.

criteria: Non-chat adapters mostly orchestrate config, HTTP calls, media loading/artifact writing, and trait implementation.
Provider-specific payload and response mapping lives under protocol modules.
Existing embedding, STT, TTS, and rerank tests still assert the same wire shapes.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo clippy -p astrbot-provider -- -D warnings
